ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising-edge timing for all clocked processes. Drives updates of synchronizer, TAP state, update trigger, TAP registers and DMI controller registers on rising_edge(clk_i).
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) guards assignments in processes tap_synchronizer, tap_control, update_trigger, reg_access, dmi_controller

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronously forces default values in clocked processes. Clears synchronizer shift registers, TAP state, update trigger, TAP registers and DMI controller fields when rstn_i = '0'.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in tap_synchronizer, tap_control, update_trigger, reg_access and dmi_controller processes

ports.name: jtag_tck_i
ports.function: JTAG TCK input sampled into synchronizer
ports.functionality: Feeds the three-stage tck shift register; sampled value is shifted into tap_sync.tck_ff each clock and used to derive tck_rising and tck_falling for TAP sequencing.
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i in process tap_synchronizer

ports.name: jtag_tdi_i
ports.function: JTAG TDI input sampled for scan shifting
ports.functionality: Shifts into tap_sync.tdi_ff on each clk; after synchronization tap_sync.tdi supplies the serial scan data used to shift IR/DR registers.
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tdi_i in tap_synchronizer

ports.name: jtag_tdo_o
ports.function: JTAG TDO output driven from TAP registers
ports.functionality: Reports selected scan bit to the external JTAG consumer. It is driven in the reg_access process on falling TCK from the active register (ireg/idcode/dtmcs/dmi/bypass).
ports.evidence: jtag_tdo_o assigned in reg_access on tap_sync.tck_falling: cases use tap_reg.ireg(0), tap_reg.idcode(0), tap_reg.dtmcs(0), tap_reg.dmi(0) or tap_reg.bypass

ports.name: jtag_tms_i
ports.function: JTAG TMS sampled for TAP state transitions
ports.functionality: Shifts into tap_sync.tms_ff and after synchronization supplies tap_sync.tms which is used by the TAP state machine to choose next states.
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tms_ff <= tap_sync.tms_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tms_i in tap_synchronizer

ports.name: dmi_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports assembled DMI request fields to the external DMI consumer; its subfields are driven continuously from the internal dmi_ctrl registers.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignments dmi_req_o.op/data/addr <= dmi_ctrl.op/wdata/addr at end of architecture

ports.name: dmi_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Continuously drives the external DMI address from internal dmi_ctrl.addr for downstream consumers.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.op
ports.functionality: Continuously presents the internal dmi_ctrl.op as the operation code to the external DMI interface.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Continuously presents internal dmi_ctrl.wdata as request write data to the external DMI consumer.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives response fields from external DMI and supplies them to internal controller logic; its fields feed dmi_ctrl.rdata and clear dmi_ctrl.busy via ack.
ports.evidence: dmi_rsp_i.data and dmi_rsp_i.ack used in process dmi_controller (rising_edge(clk_i) block)

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies readback data from the external DMI; sampled into dmi_ctrl.rdata when controller is servicing a response.
ports.evidence: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data in dmi_controller when handling busy response

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Signals completion of an outstanding DMI transaction; when '1' it causes the controller to clear dmi_ctrl.busy on the next clock.

signals.name: tap_sync
signals.functionality: Groups sampled JTAG shift registers and derived signals. Holds tck/tdi/tms shift registers and derived edge/sample signals used by TAP control and shifting logic.
signals.evidence: tap_sync record fields assigned in tap_synchronizer and concurrent assigns (tck_rising, tck_falling, tdi, tms)

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_ff
signals.functionality: Shifts in jtag_tck_i each clock into a 3-bit register used to detect rising and falling edges; provides bits used by edge detectors.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i in tap_synchronizer; tck_rising/falling use tck_ff(2 downto 1)

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi_ff
signals.functionality: Shifts in jtag_tdi_i each clock; its top bit is presented as tap_sync.tdi for shifting TAP registers during IR/DR shift states.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tdi_i; tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2)

signals.name: tap_sync.tms_ff
signals.functionality: Shifts in jtag_tms_i each clock; its top bit is presented as tap_sync.tms for the TAP state machine to sample and choose transitions.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms_ff <= tap_sync.tms_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tms_i; tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2)

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_rising
signals.functionality: Is asserted when the top two bits of tck_ff form '01', indicating a synchronized rising TCK; used to enable TAP state transitions and shifting on the next clock.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_rising <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "01") else '0' (concurrent)

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_falling
signals.functionality: Is asserted when tck_ff top two bits form '10', indicating a synchronized falling TCK; used to trigger jtag_tdo_o updates and other falling-edge behavior.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_falling <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "10") else '0' (concurrent) and used in reg_access

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi
signals.functionality: Presents the synchronized TDI top bit (tap_sync.tdi_ff(2)) for use in shifting IR/DR registers during IR_SHIFT/DR_SHIFT operations.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2) (concurrent); tap_sync.tdi used in reg_access shifts

signals.name: tap_sync.tms
signals.functionality: Presents the synchronized TMS top bit used by the TAP state machine to select next states in the tap_control process.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2) (concurrent); tap_sync.tms used in tap_control case branches

signals.name: tap_ctrl_state
signals.functionality: Implements the JTAG TAP state machine. It updates on tck_rising using tap_sync.tms to choose the next enumerated state and gates IR/DR capture/shift/update behavior.
signals.evidence: tap_ctrl_state assigned in tap_control on rising_edge(clk_i) when tap_sync.tck_rising='1'; compared in update_trigger and reg_access to govern captures/shifts

signals.name: tap_reg
signals.functionality: Holds instruction (ireg) and data registers (idcode, dtmcs, dmi, bypass); fields update on capture/shift and provide data to jtag_tdo_o and DMI controller.
signals.evidence: tap_reg fields assigned in reg_access process and dtmcs_nxt/dmi_nxt computed concurrently

signals.name: tap_reg.ireg
signals.functionality: Holds the current IR instruction; loads addr_idcode_c on reset/IR_CAPTURE or shifts in tap_sync.tdi during IR_SHIFT; selects which DR is active via case statements.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.ireg <= addr_idcode_c or <= tap_sync.tdi & tap_reg.ireg(...) in reg_access; case tap_reg.ireg selects DR behavior

signals.name: tap_reg.bypass
signals.functionality: Acts as the bypass data register when no other DR is selected; shifts in tap_sync.tdi during DR_SHIFT and drives jtag_tdo_o when selected.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.bypass <= tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT else <= '0' in DR_CAPTURE; used in reg_access for jtag_tdo_o default

signals.name: tap_reg.idcode
signals.functionality: On DR_CAPTURE it is loaded from the IDCODE generics concatenated with a low bit; it also shifts serially during DR_SHIFT using tap_sync.tdi and provides its LSB to jtag_tdo_o.
signals.evidence: when addr_idcode_c => tap_reg.idcode <= IDCODE_VERSION & IDCODE_PARTID & IDCODE_MANID & '1' (DR_CAPTURE); shift uses tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs
signals.functionality: On DR_CAPTURE it loads dtmcs_nxt; it can be shifted via DR_SHIFT and its LSB is presented on jtag_tdo_o. It supplies control bits used by the DMI controller via dtmcs_nxt construction.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dtmcs <= tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt in DR_CAPTURE; shift case updates dtmcs with tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT; jtag_tdo_o uses dtmcs(0)

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt
signals.functionality: Assembles the next DTMCS value combinationally from dmi_ctrl flags, slices of dmi_nxt and constants; used to update tap_reg.dtmcs on DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignments set dtmcs_nxt bits from dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset/dmireset, tap_reg.dmi_nxt(1 downto 0), constants

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi
signals.functionality: Holds the DMI packet shifted in or captured on DR_CAPTURE from dmi_nxt; the DMI controller reads address, wdata and op slices from this register to start transactions.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dmi <= tap_reg.dmi_nxt (DR_CAPTURE); shifts and DR_SHIFT assign dmi from tap_sync.tdi; dmi_ctrl reads dmi(40 downto 34), dmi(33 downto 02), dmi(1 downto 0)

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi_nxt
signals.functionality: Combines dmi_ctrl.addr, dmi_ctrl.rdata and replicated dmi_ctrl.err into the DMI register next value; used to update tap_reg.dmi on capture.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err, 2) (concurrent)

signals.name: dr_trigger
signals.functionality: Captures a two-stage sampled DR_UPDATE event in sreg and provides a single-cycle valid pulse when the pattern '01' occurs to trigger DMI controller actions.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.sreg assigned in update_trigger process; dr_trigger.valid derived concurrently from dr_trigger.sreg

signals.name: dr_trigger.sreg
signals.functionality: Sets bit0 when tap_ctrl_state equals DR_UPDATE on clock and shifts the previous bit into bit1; used to generate a one-cycle valid pulse when pattern '01' appears.
signals.evidence: update_trigger process sets dr_trigger.sreg(0) based on (tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE) and shifts sreg(1) <= sreg(0); dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when sreg = "01"

signals.name: dr_trigger.valid
signals.functionality: Is asserted for one cycle when sreg is '01', signalling a DR update event. It is observed by the DMI controller to initiate or update control fields.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when (dr_trigger.sreg = "01"); dr_trigger.valid used in dmi_controller conditions to set dmi_ctrl fields

signals.name: dmi_ctrl
signals.function: DMI controller state and data bundle
signals.functionality: Holds DMI transaction state (busy/op) and transaction fields (addr,wdata,rdata,err). It responds to DR update triggers and dmi responses to start/complete transactions and drives dmi_req_o outputs.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller process assigns dmi_ctrl fields on rising_edge(clk_i) and reset

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.busy
signals.functionality: Indicates an in-progress DMI transaction. It is set when the controller starts an op from tap_reg.dmi and cleared when dmi_rsp_i.ack is observed.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.busy set/cleared in dmi_controller; busy compared (dmi_ctrl.busy = '0'/'1') to choose other assignments

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.op
signals.functionality: Holds the operation code (nop/rd/wr) for outgoing DMI requests; defaults to nop and is loaded from tap_reg.dmi when a new request is started.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.op <= dmi_req_nop_c then possibly set to tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) in dmi_controller when starting request

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset
signals.functionality: Captured from tap_reg.dtmcs(17) on DR_CAPTURE when dr_trigger.valid and ireg select DTMCS; otherwise cleared when no busy condition. Affects controller reset/error handling and gating of new ops.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(17) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c in dmi_controller; later dmihardreset used in conditions

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmireset
signals.functionality: Captured from tap_reg.dtmcs(16) on DR_CAPTURE when dr_trigger.valid and ireg select DTMCS; used to clear err and to affect DMI behavior.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c in dmi_controller

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.err
signals.functionality: Records an error condition (set on busy collision, cleared on resets) and is reflected back into the DMI register readback via tap_reg.dmi_nxt.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.err set/cleared in dmi_controller; tap_reg.dmi_nxt includes replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err, 2)

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.rdata
signals.functionality: Captures response read data from dmi_rsp_i.data while busy and supplies it into the DMI register readback (dmi_nxt) for capture by JTAG.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data in dmi_controller; dmi_ctrl.rdata used in tap_reg.dmi_nxt concurrent assignment

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.wdata
signals.functionality: Loaded from tap_reg.dmi write-data slice when a request starts and exported to dmi_req_o.data for the external DMI consumer.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02) when starting request in dmi_controller; dmi_req_o.data <= dmi_ctrl.wdata

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.addr
signals.functionality: Loaded from tap_reg.dmi address slice when a DMI request starts and exported to dmi_req_o.addr for the external DMI consumer.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34) in dmi_controller when starting request; dmi_req_o.addr <= dmi_ctrl.addr
